title: NGC 3137, a starry spiral
caption: The spiral galaxy NGC 3137, imaged by the Hubble Space Telescope
celestial: NGC 3137 · NGC 3175 group · constellation Antlia · about 53 million light-years away (source figure)
credit: ESA/Hubble & NASA, D. Thilker and the PHANGS-HST Team

recognition.text: ESA/Hubble Picture of the Month, April 2026 (an editorial selection, not an audience score).

story: Loose, feathery spiral arms dotted with star clusters sweep around the dusty center of NGC 3137, a spiral galaxy about 53 million light-years away in Antlia, the Air Pump. We see it steeply tilted, which gives its arms their distinctive look.

The clusters are the stars of the show: groups of bright blue stars and glowing red gas clouds, the red marking hot young stars still surrounded by the nebulae they were born in. At the center, ringed by fine dusty clouds, sits a black hole estimated at 60 million times the Sun’s mass.

NGC 3137 travels with a group of galaxies thought to resemble our own Local Group. Like the Milky Way and Andromeda, the group has two large spirals, NGC 3137 and NGC 3175, plus smaller dwarf galaxies; researchers have found more than 500 candidates. Studying it may help explain our own neighborhood.
scale: Using the source’s listed field of view (2.76 × 2.55 arcminutes) and its distance of about 53 million light-years, the frame spans roughly 42551 × 39314 light-years. Its light set out about 53 million years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: Hubble’s cameras through six filters, from ultraviolet to near-infrared, including one for glowing hydrogen. The color assigned to each filter isn’t published.
understand.eye: Ultraviolet and near-infrared light are invisible to the eye, and the colors are assigned, so the eye would not see this palette.
filters: 657 nm · Optical H-alpha + N II (Hubble WFC3)

explore: The image combines six color bands from a Hubble program studying star clusters in 55 nearby galaxies, part of the PHANGS project, which pairs Hubble with Webb and the ALMA radio telescopes.
alt: A tilted spiral galaxy with loose, feathery arms sprinkled with blue star clusters and red glowing clouds around a dusty core.
